title: The Broken Bridge
text: The bridge the Lost crossed is down, its ropes trailing in the gorge. The cuts are clean. They cut it behind them, on purpose, to stop whatever was following. On this side of the gorge, whatever it was is still pacing up and down.

options.label: Rebuild the bridge, with your backs to the thing pacing.

outcomes.text: Slow work, and whatever they fled is still here, and tired of waiting.

options.label: The quickest climbs down and across the gorge.

outcomes.text: Across, hands torn on the rock, and a rope down for the rest.
A day lost, and the Lost are further away.
